title: FAITH FOR THE
NEXT GENERATION
end: The Family Altar — cover your home in prayer
stock_queries: warm lamp lit open bible on wooden table
golden hour sunlight through window onto dusty room
branches of olive tree in ceramic vase
soft focus view of quiet country home porch
dew on green leaves in morning light
open vintage bible with leather cover

scenes.a: If you are questioning your influence over your child's heart, stay for this quiet prayer.
Lord, we lift every parent feeling the heavy weight of responsibility for their little ones.
Train up a child in the way he should go: and when he is old, he will not depart from it.
Give us patience to lead with love when our own wisdom seems to fall so short.
Anchor their souls in the truth of your spirit so they remain rooted in your grace.
We entrust our future generations to you, knowing you are faithful to finish your good work.
